'''Dagannoth Supreme''' is the [[Ranged]]-based [[Dagannoth King]] found in the depths of the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]], along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, [[Dagannoth Rex]] and [[Dagannoth Prime]]. Supreme is the only monster to drop the [[archers ring]] and [[seercull]]. He, along with the other [[Dagannoth (race)|Dagannoth]] Kings, can also drop the [[dragon axe]].

His Ranged attack sounds like the [[Water Wave]] spell when hitting players and, in a similar fashion to [[Magic]] attacks, will "splash" if it misses. It can also attack multiple players at once, sending projectiles at any player standing within the 6x6 area around his target.

Dagannoth Supreme spawns and roams on the western side of the Dagannoth Kings' lair. The lair is accessible via the [[Kings' ladder]] deep within the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]]. A separate lair where players that have a Dagannoth [[Slayer task]] can attack the Kings is accessible by using the "Slayer" option on the ladder. The lair can be peeked at to see if other players are inside it via the ladder and a [[Crack (Waterbirth Island Dungeon)|crack]] inside a safe room nearby the ladder.

==Strategy==
{{Main|Dagannoth Kings/Strategies}}
Dagannoth Supreme is most weak to [[melee]] attacks. The best weapons to use primarily are the [[abyssal whip]] or [[abyssal tentacle|tentacle]] due to its high [[Strength#Strength bonus|Strength bonus]] and fast attack rate, the [[Saradomin godsword]] for its [[special attack]], accuracy, and Strength bonus, and [[Guthan's warspear]], which should only be used in conjunction with the rest of [[Guthan's armour]] set to heal. If a player does not possess a Saradomin godsword or [[Crystal halberd]], a [[Dragon dagger]] is a good alternative [[special attack]] weapon.

The biggest threat when killing Dagannoth Supreme is that [[Dagannoth Prime]] may respawn while killing Supreme. To save yourself from Prime's hard-hitting magical attacks, turn on [[Protect from Magic]]. You can either stick around or leave up the ladder. Another possible threat is that [[Dagannoth Rex]] may respawn instead of Prime. If this happens and you are a [[mage]], distract him again like in first wave. However, the mage should feel no inclination to kill Rex; just lure him away. Another strategy is to make use of [[Entangle]] or [[ice spells]] to deal with Rex.

==Trivia==
* The Dagannoth Supreme's examine text references an entity called the [[Bukalla]]. This entity was originally planned to be a tribe of vikings that the Supreme had conquered,{{CiteReddit|author=Mod James|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/4hha91/i_used_to_work_on_rs_ask_me_selected_things/d2pqszd/|title=I used to work on RS, Ask Me Selected Things?|quote=This is another example of me dropping something I could come back to later on - I had no specific plans, but I was more leaning towards it being a 'lost tribe' of vikings than an individual. Obviously someone else went somewhere else with that though XD|date=3 May 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97730|archivedate=6 October 2018|notes=}} but the Bukalla eventually turned out to be a legendary [[Fremennik]] warrior.
* Unlike the other Dagannoth Kings, Supreme does not have an experience modifier. Due to this, he awards 255 Slayer experience rather than 331.4 Slayer experience.
